summary: Focused frontend UI test of the Leads / Lead Generation module discoverability + CRUD flows for Openspace Agency OS. Manager (Yusuf) and team member (Rupali) both see the new 'Sales & Growth' sidebar section with a 'Lead Generation' entry (data-testid=nav-leads). Dashboard shows the prominent gradient shortcut card (data-testid=dashboard-leads-card) with the correct 'Sales & Growth · Lead Generation' / 'Manage your sales pipeline' copy and live counts; clicking navigates to /leads. On /leads: Add-lead modal opens, submit creates a lead (Test Co) that appears in the table, live dedup warning fires when re-adding the same company. Board view (leads-board), Funnel view (funnel-view) and Table view all render. Lead detail modal opens, tabs are present, and adding a touch via touch-text + add-touch-btn appends it to the Activity list. Rupali (team member) can access /leads too.
action_items: OPTIONAL / minor testid naming mismatch: review_request expected data-testid values 'tab-activity' and 'tab-ai-intro' on the lead detail modal tabs, but the current implementation uses 'tab-touches' and 'tab-draft' (see /app/frontend/src/pages/Leads.jsx lines 466-467). Functionally the tabs work and their visible labels ('Activity (n)', 'AI intro') match the spec; only the testid strings differ. If the E1 agent wants perfect alignment with the request spec, rename testids to tab-activity/tab-ai-intro. Not user-visible.
critical_code_review_comments: Leads.jsx is 639 lines and contains list page, board, funnel, add modal, detail modal, tab bar helper and Input/Select helpers in one file — consider splitting into subcomponents for maintainability.
AddLeadModal dedup preview effect (line 281-288) does not handle the api.get promise rejection — a failing /leads/dedup call will produce an unhandled promise rejection. Wrap in try/catch.
onClick={onClose} is on the modal backdrop AND on the inner container with stopPropagation — works, but if user clicks outside during in-flight submit the request is not aborted; low priority.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 test lead via UI: company='Test Co', contact_email='t@test.co'. Also appended a touch 'Called client, went well' to that lead. Leads collection now has 2 rows (Alaya Weaves seed + Test Co).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Leads module discoverability + CRUD fully verified from UI. The only spec deviation is testid strings for lead-detail tabs (tab-touches instead of tab-activity, tab-draft instead of tab-ai-intro) — visible labels are correct. Drag-drop between board columns was not scripted (HTML5 DnD is unreliable in Playwright); backend status-move endpoint was reported green by main agent in prior curl checks.
rca of the issue: Original user complaint 'I CANNOT SEE THE LEAD GENERATION' was a pure discoverability issue. Fix (dedicated 'Sales & Growth' sidebar section + gradient dashboard-leads-card) verified working for both manager and team roles: sidebar entry visible in default nav, and dashboard card visible above-the-fold on the manager dashboard. No functional bug — module was already built and functional.
